entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number 788-14B.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Series jersey. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is just too tight across the shoulders.
I understand. I see you purchased this about two months ago. Would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size, or are you just looking to return it?
No exchange, just a return. Can you do it or not?

Yes, absolutely. Just one moment while I check the policy for that item... Okay, it looks like that jersey is a standard item and you are well within the 90-day return window. I've approved the return for you.

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Okay, got the email. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
